images.name: Melt monument
images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: one square 1254x1254 standalone food-campaign art image for a Pro 'Food Fantasy' catalog. Deliberately surreal, hyperreal food art: tactile appetizing food textures paired with impossible/exaggerated scale and motion, noticeably more extravagant than a realistic restaurant photograph. Premium art direction, controlled composition, strong studio light, no text, logos, watermarks, interface or collage. Food still recognizable, not plastic or cartoon. Leave enough safe margin for the whole composition. Scene: fiery saturated orange-red seamless backdrop. A single cheeseburger in a low cream paper tray becomes a towering sculptural hero: one bun and one patty, huge extravagant golden melted-cheese folds draped like silk ribbons down the patty and into the tray, visibly exaggerated cheese proportions, gently stretched bun and patty scale, crisp lettuce, pickles. Low angle macro advertising perspective, dramatic side light, molten satin highlights, dark anchoring shadow. Cheeseburger elements grounded; no cheese rain or random flying bits. Bold editorial food fantasy, not an ordinary burger photograph.
